authorization: 2026-09-09 user requests smallest audited scoring implementation and independent review; no production replacement
evidence_status: week-granular reconstructed development, not historically verified pregame availability
scope: 2021-2025 CFBD weeks 1-3, FBS-vs-FBS; primary at least one season-specific ACC/Big Ten/Big 12/SEC member
why_early_only: Only early has a selected reproducible incumbent margin record. Later published simulation replay parity remains unresolved; later corrected record is diagnostic, not incumbent.
amendment: Execute only C1. Replace the proposed adapter prior-games grid with the existing ridge solver's lambda and season-aware decay grid. Use the six-contender budget for two training populations times three history windows. C2/C3 remain blocked, not silently tested or promoted.
candidate: Existing ratings.solve with explicit zero net prior for total only; recover uncentered score intercept; expected total from its separate offense/defense equations; constrain total to at least abs(frozen incumbent margin); expected home/away=(total +/- frozen margin)/2. Constraint is on expected means, not on simulated outcomes.
fixed_margin: Replay engine.solve_production_table on allowed pre-week games. Require exact 6dp parity with all 724 selected early rows before evaluation. Unratable rows remain excluded and enumerated; never call derived total an incumbent score.
source_boundary: Positive allowlisted games plus season membership only for candidate total. Incumbent anchor additionally uses existing talent/returning caches. No lines, odds, news, rankings, prose, or factor registry values in fit.
ridge_application: lambda_team=lambda_conf=lambda_hfa; other RatingParams defaults frozen, prior_strength=0, conn_veto does not gate the total feature; unseen teams explicitly use train-league score-level fallback
inner: Expanding chronological origin seasons 2020 through outer_year-1; each week's fit includes only previous seasons in the candidate history window and completed earlier weeks. Inner reference uses identical frozen margin anchor. No outer result chooses hyperparameters.
selection: Minimum mean paired team MAE, within one season-week block standard error of best choose largest ridge, then largest decay. Defaults only if no inner rows: lambda=3000, decay=.05; flag unfit and do not pass fold.
uncertainty: Covariance of paired home/away residuals from inner chronological predictions at selected hyperparameters, separately for each variant/reference. No evaluation residual enters SD/covariance. Gaussian marginal error approximation only; no literal joint score-sample API or exact-score probability. Identity probability calibration from fitted margin residual SD; evaluate reliability without recalibrating on held-out labels.
references: fixed incumbent margin + training mean total, explicitly new research reference
training mean home and away final scores, explicitly simple research baseline
metrics_and_decision: Inherit parent protocol primary/team/margin/total proper scores and practical floor .5 points/team; five outer folds and 20,000 paired week-block bootstrap seed20260908; simultaneous six comparisons; 4/5 nonnegative folds. Report season-block and leave-one-season-out sensitivity. No development result permits production or shadow activation.
window_comparisons: All six variants and references on identical primary games; report fallback/refusal counts. Compare all versus one and three years within population, paired. Do not cherry-pick evaluable games.
pressure_tests: centered-intercept recovery and paired expected-score identities
unmodified existing simulator OT/discrete support and continuous-margin support reproducer
continuous marginal tails/negative support mass/50,80,95 coverage/width and score inflation
single extreme prior result influence at each shrinkage/decay setting
state frozen before season versus weekly updating, descriptive sensitivity

blocked_hypotheses.C2_possessions: Opus drive measures have no computation/provider; regulation pace estimand unresolved. Existing simulator remains unchanged.
blocked_hypotheses.C3_units: Adjusted-unit provenance omits historical inputs and inherited season-age defect remains. Repair before feature use.
blocked_hypotheses.common_opponent_increment: No audited numerical feature in evidence layer; residual conditioning does not guarantee no redundancy. Reserve a separately preregistered chronological conditional ablation after evidence repair.
blocked_hypotheses.turnovers_returns_raw_vs_shrunken: No candidate activation in C1; demonstrate generic finite-denominator shrinkage influence in a structural stress test, not a performance claim. Actual-feature ablation deferred pending event/coverage validation.
blocked_hypotheses.statistics_vs_verified_news: No approved populated pregame corpus; comparison unavailable, never infer no effect. Synthetic poisoning tests only prove boundary.
blocked_hypotheses.historical_llm_extraction: No verified historical extraction corpus available; source-id blacklist is not an outcome-contamination audit. Historical reconstructed news cannot be used.

postmortems: Every evaluation row preserves anchor and candidate forecast, final home/away/margin/total errors, prior sample counts and predicted/observed scoring level. Pace/efficiency/field-position/personnel discrepancies unavailable unless separately reconciled; diagnostic tags cannot claim causal decomposition.
stopping: One run of six predefined variants, no expansion after results. Bug fixes require explicit invalidation and versioned rerun; failed gates retain incumbent.
